aliases: Carrier light commercial high outdoor air rooftop
applies_to: Carrier 48/50LC*H light commercial high outdoor air rooftop units (R-410A) with factory SmartVu controls version 2.X on PIC 6.0 hardware.
summary: SmartVu is a touchscreen unit control that speaks BACnet MS/TP on port J8 or BACnet IP on either Ethernet port, plus CCN. The 48/50LC*H list in this integration guide has 1,049 objects: 572 AVs, 450 BVs and 27 MVs covering temperatures, pressures, setpoints, network inputs, outputs, configuration and alert limits, unit and component states, and one BV per alarm or alert code. The guide gives object name, type, instance, access and a short description, but no units or state texts.
notes: Point availability varies by model, unit type, size and configuration; not every object exists on every unit.
The guide prints no units or multistate texts for the BACnet objects. Metric Units and Percentage Conversion settings change how values read (percentages as 0-100 or 0.00-1.00).

The guide's Appendix B prints the same 1,049-object BACnet table for 48/50V units on PIC 6.0 (only AV 571 is spelled in lower case there). Our separate 48/50K and 48/50V SmartVu PIC 6.1 entry (48-50-ART-SVU-1T) uses the same object names and instances for the 715 objects it lists.
ALM_6xxxx BVs (instances 214-450) are one flag per alarm or alert code; the description is the code only (e.g. T322, A267).
An Option column (Type 4, 5 or 6) is printed for every object but not explained in the guide; it is not captured here.

source.title: SmartVu Controls Version 2.X for Light Commercial and Applied Rooftop Gas Heat/Electric Cooling and Electric Heat/Electric Cooling Units with PIC 6.0 Hardware - Integration Guide (Appendix A: BACnet Points for 48/50LC*H)

integration.summary: On the SmartVu Controller Config screens (user password 1111) set Primary BAS Network to BACnet and BACnet Enable to MS/TP or IP, then reboot. Occupancy comes from BACnet schedule objects or the Network Occupancy point (AV 363); write the occupied setpoints directly and read unit states, temperatures and the alarm relay.

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_NETOCC
minimum_points.why: Network occupancy; Primary BAS Network must be BACnet

integration.enable: Primary BAS Network sets which network drives the occupancy schedule (BACnet, CCN, a CCN local schedule or none); CCN schedule zero makes the unit always occupied. The guide does not explain the values of Network Occupancy (GENUNIT_NETOCC, AV 363). Occupancy Source (MV 26) shows where occupancy currently comes from.
integration.heartbeat: The list includes Network Input Timeout (SERVICE_NETINTO, AV 500), but the guide does not explain it or give a default.
integration.remote_sensors: Writable network inputs include Net SPT (AV 360), Net OAT (AV 362) and network thermostat calls Network Y1/Y2/W1/W2/G/HSTAT (BV 141-146). The guide does not explain how the unit selects them.
setup: Communication settings are on the Controller Config screen, shown only after logging in with the user password 1111.

BACnet MS/TP on port J8 of the touchscreen: set Serial Port Config to MS/TP, BACnet Enable to MS/TP, then network, MAC, identifier and baud. Max Masters 127 and Max Info Frames 20 or less are recommended; 32 nodes at 76,800 baud, 16 at 38,400.
BACnet IP on Ethernet 0 (J15) or Ethernet 1 (J16); UDP 47808 by default; BACnet Mgmt Device can be None, Foreign Device or BBMD. Reboot after IP changes.
The SmartVu is locally biased: don't put it on a network-biased segment; terminate with a TERM485 instead of router end-of-line switches. Fit 120 ohms at the first and last node.
gotchas: Many configuration values are AVs or BVs without documented codes; read the current value and check the touchscreen before writing.
Percentages read as 0.00-1.00 or 0-100 depending on the Percentage Conversion setting.
Modbus BAS and Rnet on J8 are not supported in this SmartVu version.
